subject: Fit measures (TLI and SRMR) in EFA/ESEM

messages.author: 9c0963f6d077f455
messages.subject: Fit measures (TLI and SRMR) in EFA/ESEM
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm running EFA using lavaan and I can see that it gives me CFI and RMSEA but not other fit measures (like TLI, SRMR) even though they are provided with CFAs. Is there a way to obtain these fit measures with EFA?

Cheers,
Akiho

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: Fit measures (TLI and SRMR) in EFA/ESEM
parts:
Hi
put the output of your model instead of "fit"and than run this command:
fitMeasures(fit, fit.measures = "all")

messages.subject: Re: Fit measures (TLI and SRMR) in EFA/ESEM
parts:
A bit more general. Summary is a summary, based on coefficients that the programmers seem to consider particularly important. Never use summary (at best for a very rough overview). fitMeasures, parameterEsrimates, standardizedSolution or lavInspect are much more insightful.

HTH 

Christian
